MBBS Students Get One-Time Mercy Attempt for First Exam

The National Medical Commission (NMC) has granted a one-time mercy attempt to MBBS students admitted between the 2019-20 academic years to clear their first exam. The total duration for completing the MBBS course, however, remains capped at 10 years.
